# よむ (Yomu)

> よむ is a free, open-source reader for 33 learning languages. It turns web text, images, PC game captures, PDFs, and video subtitles into tappable lookup surfaces with target-aware readings or pronunciation, meanings, audio, example sentences, and study actions. Japanese adds furigana, pitch accent, kanji detail, and deeper grammar.

## Primary Links

- [Homepage](https://yomureader.com/): Product overview and install entry point.
- [Install よむ](https://yomureader.com/getting-started): Setup guide for desktop userscript managers and mobile userscript apps.
- [Features](https://yomureader.com/features): Full feature list covering popup lookup, OCR, subtitles, Anki, dictionaries, audio, examples, and study.
- [API reference](https://yomureader.com/api/): Interactive OpenAPI 3.1 explorer and JSON/YAML contracts for Yomu services.
- [Install userscript](https://yomureader.com/yomu.user.js): Current production userscript.
- [Source code](https://github.com/HRussellZFAC023/yomu-reader): MIT-licensed project repository.

## Tools

- [Japanese OCR reader](https://yomureader.com/tools/japanese-ocr): Manga and image OCR workflow.
- [Japanese subtitle reader](https://yomureader.com/tools/japanese-subtitle-reader): Video subtitle lookup and mining workflow.
- [Yomu Gaming](https://yomureader.com/tools/yomu-gaming): First-party desktop app for PC game capture and lookup.
- [Furigana reader](https://yomureader.com/tools/furigana-reader): Furigana and reading assistance.
- [Kanji stroke order](https://yomureader.com/tools/kanji-stroke-order): Kanji drilldown and stroke diagrams.
- [Study page](https://yomureader.com/tools/study-page): Standalone vocabulary Study surface.
- [YouTube Japanese](https://yomureader.com/tools/youtube-japanese): Japanese-focused YouTube filtering and subtitle support.

## Guides

- [Read manga in Japanese](https://yomureader.com/guides/read-manga-in-japanese): Manga reading setup with OCR.
- [Comprehensible input on YouTube](https://yomureader.com/guides/comprehensible-input-youtube): Japanese YouTube immersion setup.
- [Mine sentences to Anki](https://yomureader.com/guides/mine-sentences-to-anki): Anki mining flow and card creation.
- [Study setup](https://yomureader.com/guides/study-setup): Recommended learner setup.
